title: Open Trestle Review Routing Input v1
description: Canonical interchange shape for provider-neutral inputs used by later route planning. Validation does not establish request provenance, authorization, tenant or repository scope, budget, route eligibility, or dispatch authority.

request_identity.description: Canonical content-derived request fingerprint. It is linkable and dictionary-testable, not anonymization, secrecy, or provenance.

$comment: Resolvers must use a caller-supplied closed local registry. This schema does not authorize remote reference retrieval.
